messages:
oliver: Quick alert — saw a spike of fncall traffic where the console shows fallback/no-tool but traces have no validation metadata. Suspect validator soft-failed and proxy nulled the envelope.
mei: can you post the raw snippet?
oliver: anonymized edge payload:
```
{"req_id":"r-200","model":"open-7b","response":{"text":"...","tool_call":null},"validation":null
}
```
so validation is literally null. no error field, no code.
tasha: thats the "silent soft-fail" behaviour we discussed last quarter. We avoided adding validation metadata to keep billing neutral, but that makes diagnosis impossible. Support tickets just say "no tool run".
ben: proposing a small change: if validator would soft-reject, still emit a minimal envelope: `{status: \"soft_reject\", code: \"enum_mismatch\", billing_exempt: true}`. That preserves billing semantics but gives telemetry.
mei: agree. Also need metric coverage: `fncall.validation.soft_reject_total` with labels {region,route,model_variant}. Current `fncall.rejects` lumps everything.
ux-bot: UX suggestion: add a collapsed per-route badge "soft rejects" and a sampled timeline. Link each entry to request id for quick drilldown. Default collapsed.
oliver: important: router currently treats `validation==null` as success and sends requests to degen fallback route, which skews quota & SLA attribution. We should treat `status==\"soft_reject\"` as a distinct routing outcome (route=soft_reject).
ben: simple change in router: if `validation?.status == \"soft_reject\"` set route_tag = "soft_reject" else preserve existing logic. Backwards compatible if validation missing.
mei: need tests and an integration check: unit tests for router, an integration that verifies metric emits and audit log. I can add tests.
tasha: logging: emit audit line `AUDIT fncall soft_reject r-200 reason=enum_mismatch` so log pipeline can index reason fields. Regex idea: `AUDIT fncall soft_reject [a-z0-9-]+ reason=[a-z_]+`.
ben: deploy plan: 1) proxy: always attach minimal validation envelope for soft-rejects 2) router: treat soft_reject as separate route 3) metrics + audit logs 4) console feature-flagged UI + docs blurb.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiated staging rollout for proxy change (deploy id s-2001) by ben  checks running.
mei: i'll land tests and coordinate with ben on naming. Please avoid metric name churn; prefer `fncall.validation.soft_reject_total`.
ux-bot: UI will be behind flag. We'll add tooltip explaining soft vs hard rejects for support.
oliver: timeline: aim for quick mitigation (proxy + router + metrics) within 48h; UI + docs within a week. No blockers?
tasha: none from infra. I'll review test PRs.
ben: opening PRs now, tagging @mei @tasha @ux. Will report back when staging canary completes. :thumbsup:
